race.title: Racing At The Heart Of Our Community Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: FRESHERS WEEK makes plenty of appeal on the pick of last season's form. He's worth another chance with Brian Hughes taking over and his yard in superb heart. Aire Spray and Letterston Lady head the dangers in an interesting race for the grade. FRESHERS WEEK (IRE) AIRE SPRAY (IRE) LETTERSTON LADY
race.bettingForecast: Aire Spray (3/1), Seeyainthesuninn (7/2), Letterston Lady (5/1), William Yeats (6/1), Got A Dream (8/1), Imperial Merlin (12/1), Evaluation (12/1), President Scottie (12/1), Freshers Week (16/1)
